(1→4)-α-
D
-Glucan 1-α-
D
-glucosylmutase
(
EC
5.4.99.15
,
malto-oligosyltrehalose synthase
,
maltodextrin alpha-D-glucosyltransferase
) is an
enzyme
with
systematic name
(1->4)-alpha-D-glucan 1-alpha-D-glucosylmutase
.
[
1
]
[
2
]
[
3
]
This enzyme
catalyses
the following
chemical reaction
4-[(1->4)-alpha-D-glucosyl]n-1-D-glucose
⇌
{\displaystyle \rightleftharpoons }
1-alpha-D-[(1->4)-alpha-D-glucosyl]n-1-alpha-D-glucopyranoside
The enzyme from Arthrobacter sp., Sulfolobus acidocaldarius acts on (1->4)-alpha-D-glucans containing three or more (1->4)-alpha-linked D-glucose units.
